properties.label: Electrical Conductivity
properties.description: Electrical conductivity used by electromagnetic and loss calculations.

properties.label: Electrical Resistivity
properties.description: Electrical resistivity at the stated reference temperature.

properties.label: Relative Permittivity
properties.description: Relative dielectric permittivity.

properties.label: Relative Permittivity Real Part
properties.description: Real part of isotropic complex relative permittivity.
properties.note_guidance: Record frequency, temperature, and the complex-permittivity sign convention used by the target EMSolution version.

properties.label: Relative Permittivity Imaginary Part
properties.description: Loss part of isotropic complex relative permittivity.
properties.note_guidance: Record frequency, temperature, and the complex-permittivity sign convention used by the target EMSolution version.

properties.label: Relative Permittivity Real X
properties.description: X-direction real part of complex relative permittivity.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permittivity Real Y
properties.description: Y-direction real part of complex relative permittivity.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permittivity Real Z
properties.description: Z-direction real part of complex relative permittivity.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permittivity Imaginary X
properties.description: X-direction loss part of complex relative permittivity.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permittivity Imaginary Y
properties.description: Y-direction loss part of complex relative permittivity.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permittivity Imaginary Z
properties.description: Z-direction loss part of complex relative permittivity.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Dielectric Strength
properties.description: Electrical breakdown field strength.

properties.label: Resistance Temperature Coefficient
properties.description: Temperature coefficient of electrical resistance.

properties.label: Electrical Reference Temperature
properties.description: Reference temperature for conductivity, resistivity, or their coefficient.

properties.label: Mass Density
properties.description: Mass density; required to calculate Manufacturing BOM mass.

properties.label: Sheet Thickness
properties.description: Electrical steel sheet thickness used by EMSolution inputs.

properties.label: Relative Permeability
properties.description: Linear or recoil relative permeability; used as the magnetic fallback when no B-H curve is registered.

properties.label: B-H Curve
properties.description: Nonlinear magnetic curve H(A/m) to B(T).

properties.label: B-H Curve X
properties.description: X-direction nonlinear magnetic curve H(A/m) to B(T).

properties.label: B-H Curve Y
properties.description: Y-direction nonlinear magnetic curve H(A/m) to B(T).

properties.label: B-H Curve Z
properties.description: Z-direction nonlinear magnetic curve H(A/m) to B(T).

properties.label: Relative Permeability X
properties.description: X-direction linear fallback when B-H Curve X is not registered.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Y
properties.description: Y-direction linear fallback when B-H Curve Y is not registered.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Z
properties.description: Z-direction linear fallback when B-H Curve Z is not registered.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Real Part
properties.description: MU_COMPLEX real part for isotropic AC magnetic analysis.
properties.note_guidance: Record frequency, temperature, and the EMSolution convention mu' - j mu''.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Imaginary Part
properties.description: MU_COMPLEX loss part for isotropic AC magnetic analysis.
properties.note_guidance: Record frequency, temperature, and the EMSolution convention mu' - j mu''.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Real X
properties.description: X-direction MU_COMPLEX real part.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Real Y
properties.description: Y-direction MU_COMPLEX real part.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Real Z
properties.description: Z-direction MU_COMPLEX real part.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Imaginary X
properties.description: X-direction MU_COMPLEX loss part.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Imaginary Y
properties.description: Y-direction MU_COMPLEX loss part.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Relative Permeability Imaginary Z
properties.description: Z-direction MU_COMPLEX loss part.
properties.note_guidance: Record local coordinate system, frequency, temperature, and sign convention.

properties.label: Remanent Flux Density
properties.description: Intrinsic remanent flux-density magnitude; magnetization direction belongs to the component model.

properties.label: Coercive Field Strength HcB
properties.description: Coercive field strength HcB.

properties.label: Intrinsic Coercive Field Strength HcJ
properties.description: Intrinsic coercive field strength HcJ.

properties.label: Remanence Temperature Coefficient
properties.description: Temperature coefficient of remanent flux density.

properties.label: Coercivity Temperature Coefficient
properties.description: Temperature coefficient of coercive field strength.

properties.label: M-H Curve
properties.description: Measured magnetization curve H(A/m) to M(A/m). Kept in the original M-H representation; it is not an EMSolution B-H curve.
properties.note_guidance: Record the measurement temperature, magnetization convention, sample state, and any source-defined demagnetization correction.

properties.label: Ke
properties.description: Yamazaki eddy-current loss coefficient.
properties.note_guidance: Record representative magnetic flux density and fitting conditions, for example B=1.5 T and 50 Hz.

properties.label: Kh
properties.description: Yamazaki hysteresis loss coefficient.
properties.note_guidance: Record representative magnetic flux density and fitting conditions, for example B=1.5 T and 50 Hz.

properties.label: Ke_X
properties.description: Anisotropic Yamazaki eddy-current coefficient in X.
properties.note_guidance: Record representative magnetic flux density, direction, and fitting conditions.

properties.label: Ke_Y
properties.description: Anisotropic Yamazaki eddy-current coefficient in Y.
properties.note_guidance: Record representative magnetic flux density, direction, and fitting conditions.

properties.label: Kh_X
properties.description: Anisotropic Yamazaki hysteresis coefficient in X.
properties.note_guidance: Record representative magnetic flux density, direction, and fitting conditions.

properties.label: Kh_Y
properties.description: Anisotropic Yamazaki hysteresis coefficient in Y.
properties.note_guidance: Record representative magnetic flux density, direction, and fitting conditions.

properties.label: Kh_Z
properties.description: Anisotropic Yamazaki hysteresis coefficient in Z.
properties.note_guidance: Record representative magnetic flux density, direction, and fitting conditions.

properties.label: Thermal Conductivity
properties.description: Isotropic thermal conductivity.

properties.label: Thermal Conductivity vs Temperature
properties.description: Source-declared temperature-dependent thermal conductivity.
properties.note_guidance: Record source temperature range, sample state, and whether values are measured or derived.

properties.label: Specific Heat
properties.description: Specific heat capacity.

properties.label: Maximum Operating Temperature
properties.description: Recommended maximum continuous operating temperature.

properties.label: Young's Modulus
properties.description: Elastic Young's modulus.

properties.label: Poisson's Ratio
properties.description: Dimensionless Poisson's ratio.

properties.label: Yield Strength
properties.description: Mechanical yield strength.
